external_reference.description: Your own identifier for this company (for example a CRM id). Unique per partner, compared byte-exact after trimming surrounding whitespace (case-sensitive): creating a second company with the same value returns 409 company_exists with the existing company_id. Filter with ?external_reference= on the list endpoint.

id.description: Stable identifier for this resource.

legal_representatives.description: People or organizations legally representing the company.

name.description: Registered or trading name of the company.

notification_channels.description: Company-level email recipients for operational notifications.

onboarding_mode.description: Selected mode for this Partner-company relationship. Read-only after creation.

onboarding_status.description: Administrator confirmation status: confirmation_not_required for api_only; confirmation_pending for provisional web_flow; confirmed for confirmed web_flow. Poll this field independently of membership setup or email delivery.

payout_bank_account.description: Account to which collected funds are transferred.

phone.description: Primary telephone number of the company in E.164 format; `null` clears it.

sandbox_origin.description:
Provenance of this record. `sandbox_native` — created inside the sandbox and therefore a test resource you fully own. `production_mirror` — a read-only copy of a production record. `unclassified` — everything else, including every record in production. Determines what may be changed in the sandbox, so it is published rather than left to guesswork.

* `production_mirror` - Production mirror
* `sandbox_native` - Sandbox native
* `unclassified` - Unclassified

external_reference.description: Your identifier for this company, unique within your partner organization. A duplicate returns 409 company_exists with the existing company_id. Omit or set null if you do not assign one. Filter by ?external_reference= on the company list.

legal_form.description: Permanent public code from GET /legal-forms/, or null when not set. A non-null legal_form is required when legal_representatives is nonempty. On PATCH, omission preserves the current form; it cannot be cleared while retaining representatives. Changes follow the paywise UI identity lock: after transfer for processing, or once company data is complete and a case has been submitted.

legal_representatives.description: People or organizations legally representing the company, up to three, with roles matching legal_form. A nonempty array requires a non-null legal_form. They cannot be changed once company data submission is complete, even before the first case submission. Maximum 3 entries; exceeding this limit returns 400 validation_error.

name.description: Registered or trading name of the company. Changes follow the paywise UI identity lock: after transfer for processing, or once company data is complete and a case has been submitted.

notification_channels.description: Company-level email recipients for operational notifications, up to 10. Omit or send [] if no company-level recipients are supplied yet. Each recipient has its own notification selection.

onboarding_mode.description: Required choice of api_only or web_flow for this company. paywise must enable the exact corresponding Partner entitlement; wildcard scopes grant neither. Missing mode returns 400 onboarding_mode_required; an unentitled mode returns 403 onboarding_mode_not_allowed. The selected mode cannot be changed by PATCH (409 onboarding_mode_immutable).

payout_bank_account.description: Account to which collected funds are transferred. Omit or set null if no account is provided yet. After the first case submission, changes must use the secured payout-account change process in the paywise UI.

phone.description: Primary telephone number of the company in E.164 format; `null` clears it.

tax_treatment.description: Company VAT treatment, consistent with the address country. reverse_charge requires vat_number. Changes follow the paywise UI identity lock: after transfer for processing, or once company data is complete and a case has been submitted.

users.description: Users to invite to the managed company during creation, up to 10. Omit or send [] to create the company without users. A nonempty array must include at least one entry with role admin; its position in the array does not matter. Each is created as pending_setup and gains access only after accepting the setup invitation. Manage memberships through the company users endpoints after creation. Each inline membership also consumes one of the Partner-wide 60 membership additions per hour; company creation consumes one of 30 company creations per hour. All credentials share these allowances. Only successful non-replay commands count. If either allowance is exceeded, the entire command returns 429 throttled with Retry-After and creates nothing.

vat_number.description: Company VAT identification number. Required when tax_treatment is reverse_charge. Changes follow the paywise UI identity lock: after transfer for processing, or once company data is complete and a case has been submitted.

post.description: End all of this partner's access to a managed company. The company keeps its submitted cases, users, portal access and any credentials of its own. Orders this partner created on the company's behalf and never submitted are deleted; submitted orders and the company's own drafts survive. The company's `external_reference` is cleared so the same reference can onboard a fresh company later; the record itself stays attributed to the partner for history.
